notes: The three main animal characters are lion, tiger, and dog — all central to the story and worth naming individually on the board. 'Bird' appears in the climactic parade/chase scene and is worth including. 'Stack' and 'try' capture the core repetitive actions of the book (stacking apples, trying to balance) and support retelling. 'Ten' is thematically critical as the target number throughout. Core words 'more' and 'again' are already in core rows and do not need fringe slots. The existing activity_images already include apple, ten, count, tiger, dog, lion, balance, and fall — all of these are reused here, reducing new asset creation needed.
